text: End of course test Track 1 Where did you go on your holiday? I took a bus across America from New York to San Francisco. It took 18 days and it was so interesting. Wasn't it boring on the bus? No. We didn't stay on the bus all the time. We went to two national parks, Yosemite and the Grand Canyon. I think Yosemite was better than the Grand Canyon because there were fewer people. There were over 500 when I was at the Grand Canyon. There's a bridge made of glass and you can stand on it and look down at the river. I know it's not dangerous but I felt uncomfortable standing on it and didn't really like it. Was it hot? Yes, but it rained too. I didn't like that. But Yosemite Park was amazing. There were lots of trees so it was very green and not too hot. I loved it there. Where did you go next? To San Francisco. You should go there. It has lots of unusual shops and fantastic food. One pizza restaurant made 30 different kinds of pizza and they weren't like the fast food pizzas we get here. More like the ones my grandmother cooked at home. Did you stay in a hotel? Yes, in San Francisco we did. It was cheap and small. There were only six rooms and the other people staying there were nice. The city is amazing. I think you should visit too. You'd love it.

To San Francisco.
